```plato

    //==
    // # Matrix4x4 construction — billboards
    //
    // Placements that keep a flat object turned toward the camera.

    // The spherical billboard at `objectPosition`: the object's +Z is turned to
    // face the camera outright. When the camera sits on the object (within 1e-4
    // squared units) the camera's own forward direction is used instead.
    CreateBillboard(_: Matrix4x4, objectPosition: Point3D, cameraPosition: Point3D, cameraUpVector: Vector3D, cameraForwardVector: Vector3D): Matrix4x4 {
        var eps = 0.0001;
        var toObject = cameraPosition.Between(objectPosition);
        var zaxis = toObject.LengthSquared < eps ? -cameraForwardVector : toObject.Normalize;
        var xaxis = cameraUpVector.Cross(zaxis).Normalize;
        var yaxis = zaxis.Cross(xaxis);
        return (Number4(xaxis.X, xaxis.Y, xaxis.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(yaxis.X, yaxis.Y, yaxis.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(zaxis.X, zaxis.Y, zaxis.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(objectPosition.X, objectPosition.Y, objectPosition.Z, 1.0));
    }
```
